bullets: Fixed coding assistant answers so the main response shows before suggestion cards, preventing cards from appearing without text.
Improved error messages for the site deployment tool so they point to the specific argument that failed instead of blaming the request.
Updated Windows terminal commands so failed results now include a brief hint explaining which terminal type is actually running.
Added Crouton Alpha to the top of the standard section in the free model picker for all Freebuff and Codebuff users.
Updated the assistant to proactively suggest connecting apps when doing so makes a task faster or more accurate.
Changed the escape key interrupt so the system records that the user personally stopped the task rather than a general session shutdown.
Updated model retirement tracking to gently redirect users who saved a retired model to a recommended alternative instead of showing an error.
